themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously or with minimal human intervention, including autonomous research platforms and agent-based research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, including code generation and completion functionalities.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Research and development involving simulated individuals or 'digital twins' used for testing, surveying, or understanding user behavior.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles covering a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to assist researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI technologies that condense large amounts of text, audio, or video into concise summaries for easier comprehension.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Studies and discussions on the use, impact, and implications of AI chatbots, particularly in user interaction and research contexts.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores how AI is being integrated into the design process, from generating design elements to aiding in user interface and experience research.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Articles on AI's application in qualitative research methods, such as interviews, thematic analysis, and understanding nuanced user feedback.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Content focused on comparing, reviewing, and assessing the effectiveness of various AI tools for specific research and design tasks.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and discussion on how AI is affecting employment, job roles, recruitment, and the skills required in the modern workforce.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
